extracted.intended_audience: established biomedical and basic biological researchers (including physician-scientists) considering HHMI Investigator appointment; university research administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and program expectations for appointment as an HHMI Investigator, including eligibility rules, employment/term arrangements, research and equipment support, and expectations for mentoring and community participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — minimum independent faculty experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility for the program has been expanded to include scientists who have held their first independent faculty position for a minimum of seven years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'scientists who have held their first independent faculty position for a minimum of seven years.' No upper career-stage limit is imposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: No upper career-stage limit
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no upper career-stage limit for applicants to the Investigator program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'with no upper career-stage limit.' This means both mid-career and senior faculty may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research profile — established, boundary-pushing researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators are established researchers who push the boundaries of basic biological and biomedical sciences, working across many scientific disciplines and a wide range of organisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original phrasing: 'HHMI Investigators are established researchers... who push the boundaries of basic biological and biomedical sciences, working across many scientific disciplines in a wide range of organisms.' Implies expectation of ambitious, discipline-spanning fundamental research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record of recognized fundamental discoveries / high impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators' fundamental discoveries have been broadly recognized by the scientific community (the page cites Nobel Prizes among current/emeriti Investigators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This conveys an implicit criterion of a strong track record of significant, recognized scientific contributions; original text: 'their fundamental discoveries have been broadly recognized by the scientific community, including Nobel Prizes awarded to more than 30 current or emeriti Investigators.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to inclusive, collaborative mentorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators create inclusive, collaborative research environments that prepare early career scientists for future success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Investigators create inclusive, collaborative research environments that prepare early career scientists for future success.' This is an expectation of mentoring, lab culture, and training activities as part of the Investigator role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employment arrangement — HHMI employee with home institution affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators are HHMI employees who receive full salary and benefits from the Institute while maintaining academic appointments and labs at their home institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original phrasing: 'Investigators are HHMI employees who receive full salary and benefits from the Institute while maintaining academic appointments and labs at their home institutions.' This specifies the employment and institutional affiliation model for the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term length and renewability
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators are appointed to a seven-year, renewable term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Once appointed to a seven-year, renewable term, Investigators receive financial support for their research...' Renewal is contingent on successful review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial support and research budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators receive financial support for their research, including full salary, benefits, and research budgets through the Institute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original phrasing: 'Investigators receive their full salary, benefits, and research budgets through the Institute.' The page emphasizes generous support enabling pursuit of bold ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital equipment support / equipment allotment
rubrics_metrics.description: As a supplement to core support, Investigators may submit capital equipment requests to the Institute for scientific equipment necessary to their research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Robust equipment allotment... Investigators may also submit capital equipment requests to the Institute for scientific equipment necessary to their research.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Community membership and collaborative opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigators join a large, active HHMI community that spans career stages and provides collaboration and scientific meeting participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original phrasing: 'Investigators are part of a large, active community of HHMI scientists spanning career stages who collaborate and attend scientific meetings to share new research.' Also includes induction into HHMI communities such as Freeman Hrabowski Scholars, Hanna Gray and Gilliam Fellows.
